about: Estevan is a city in southeastern Saskatchewan near the U.S. border, known for coal mining, power generation, and oilfield activity. A prairie energy hub on the Souris River country, it serves surrounding farm and resource communities along Highway 39. About 11,000 people live in Estevan.
seoSummary: Southeastern Saskatchewan energy city near the U.S. border—coal, power, and oilfield hub on Highway 39.
